checks.name: independent-review-performed
checks.details: Different participant checked the fixed history, current sources, retained events and proposal lifecycle and recorded itemized verdicts.
criteria: 核对来源前后与事件回执，确认未丢失结果或重复交付。

checks.name: provenance-and-gaps-preserved
checks.details: The review binds source and artifact hashes, retains the missing checkpoint and real failures, and leaves unknown business facts unresolved.
criteria: 保留实际产物与来源引用，无法确认的内容显式说明。

checks.name: verdict-boundary
checks.details: The review requires producer corrections for unapplied confirmed changes and inconsistent recovery state; it does not grant final delivery or E4.
